admission.justification: Prevent redundant copy judgments and history-row workarounds that leave the actual literal target or design rationale unresolved.

applicability: Curator instructions for grouped uncovered judgments, reconsideration repair and removed record-link targets.
conditions: The representative row binds every grouped candidate path/blob; equal declared generated copies and divergent/ordinary paths retain their distinct ruled treatment.
Stale reconsideration needs recomputation/currentness recovery and a broken non-reconsideration link needs a literal record-link repair, not a history-row workaround.
Continuing by-design choices retain the actual rejected alternative and reason as decisions; no omission is treated as future work.
exclusions: Instruction source is not proof of completed native decisions, executed tests or final readiness.
statement: Curator instructions must describe grouped judgments, reconsideration recovery and link-target obligations, and curation must record the continuing by-design choices without inventing alternatives.
